brand.name: Vertex Web Solutions
brand.logo_concept: Generated text+icon logo with a stylized 'V' / triangular vertex mark using pure SVG paths.

mono_labels.usage: Overlines, tech stats, developer-like data points

design_system.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-12 inside bento grids. py-24 to py-32 for main sections.
design_system.layout: Strict grid-based bento layouts. Mobile-first stacking to 3 or 4 columns on desktop.
design_system.surfaces: Crystal Glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D0E15]/60 with 1px inner top border (box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05)).
design_system.borders: 1px solid borders for all structural elements. Never use muddy gray drop shadows. Rely on background contrasts and thin glowing borders for focus states.
design_system.cursor: Implement a custom cursor glow effect (a div following the mouse with a radial gradient blur) for desktop users.

animations.scroll: MANDATORY: Smooth scrolling using Framer Motion or pure CSS smooth-scroll on html.
animations.micro_interactions: Buttons and cards scale up to scale-105 on hover. Active elements pulse subtly.
animations.backgrounds: Implement a pure CSS digital grid (background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px)...) overlaying a deep navy canvas.
animations.reveals: Use framer-motion 'whileInView' to create staggered fade-up effects (y: 20, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1) on all sections.

buttons.primary: Solid #FFFFFF background with #05050A text. Font weight 600. Hover: scale 0.98 and drop-shadow-cyan glow.
buttons.secondary: Glass outline. bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/5. Transition-all duration-300.

cards.bento: Rounded-xl or 2xl (max), bg-[#0D0E15] border border-white/5. On hover: border-cyan-500/50 and add a soft cyan inner-glow.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: NO PHOTOS. NO EXTERNAL IMAGES. DO NOT load any image assets. You MUST build visual assets (dashboards, mockups, graphs, call waveforms) using raw HTML/CSS divs, Framer Motion, SVGs, and Lucide icons.

testing.data_testid_rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

sections_breakdown.description: Sticky Glass Navbar (z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#05050A]/70). Pure SVG 'V' logo + Vertex text. Right-aligned Phone CTA button (tel:3054693585). Mobile menu with slide-in.

Animated Hero. H1 in Clash Display text-5xl md:text-7xl. Layout: 2 columns on desktop. Right column contains a Floating AI Dashboard Visualization built with pure CSS/Framer Motion (mock UI cards, floating stat bars, glowing nodes). Particles/grid background.
3 Problem Cards: Missed calls, Weak online presence, Inconsistent marketing. 3-column bento grid. Accents of subtle red/amber danger glows.
3 Service Cards with glowing Lucide icons: AI Voice, Website Building, Social Media. Layout: Bento grid layout.
System Flow Diagram showcasing the 'Vertex Ecosystem'. Built with pure CSS connecting lines and SVG animated glowing dots tracking along the lines between service nodes.
Animated call interface. Render a phone frame purely in CSS. Show an audio waveform (animated div bars scaling randomly), transcript bubbles appearing dynamically, and a 'lead captured' summary card.
Website Building Showcase. Animated 3D mockup built with pure CSS transforms (perspective, rotateX, rotateY) showing a floating wireframe.
Animated post feed mockup. A column of skeleton UI post cards scrolling vertically in an infinite loop using Framer Motion.
18 cards with Lucide icons + hover glow. Dense grid layout (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6). Gap-4.
4 Cards detailing Vertex advantages. Large JetBrains Mono numbers overlaid as background watermarks in the cards.
CSS scrolling marquee (react-fast-marquee or CSS keyframes) of text-only testimonials with SVG star ratings.
4 option cards simulating the receptionist routing tree. Clicking an option highlights the path.
Massive text CTA 'Upgrade Your Business' with a triangular network animation background. Huge tap-to-call button.
Minimal luxury footer. Grid links, legal text, stylized brand mark.
